name: Strategy Map
tagline: Strategy map language: parchment background, tile blue accent, hexagonal grid and mono imprint tables.
best: strategy game, map screen, resource management panel
avoid: fast arcade action, neon night aesthetic
signature: **Parchment floor:** light, warm neutral; accent single tile blue.
**Map texture:** fine grid on `--bg-2` only; the text remains on the opaque surface.
**Mono imprint:** source tables Courier Prime 11px, tabular.
**Thin frame:** map frame 1px ink 20%.
must: Source numbers mono and tabular; unit is written.
The map/text distinction is established by ground tone, not shadow.
Accent is just selection and measurement.
essence: Strategy Map does not write on the map: the map and the imprint are on separate layers, and the decision is made at a glance.
brief: Design strategy map display: parchment floor, china blue accent only on selection, mono resource tables, slim bezel.

name: Sim Builder
tagline: City-building interface: turquoise accent, restrained round panel, resource counters and calm intensity.
feeling: orderly, calm, "everything goes according to plan"
best: simulation/building game, resource management, planning panel
avoid: aggressive competitive displays, atmosphere of fear
signature: **Turquoise accent:** single vibrant color; resource icons remain neutral.
**Scale round:** 6/12px; simulation panels look like boxes, not buttons.
**Resource counters:** mono 12px, icon + value + delta.
**Calm density:** card spacing 18px, partition 64px.
must: Resource and production values are taboos; delta (+/−) is displayed.
Accent selected/active status only.
The corner stays within 6–12px.
essence: Sim Builder reads resources like a table: each number an input to a decision, each panel a production step.
brief: Design city building game panel: turquoise accent in lone selection, 6/12px round panel, mono resource counters, calm density.

name: Arcade Cabinet
tagline: Cabinet art language: red-blue on yellow, bold contour, box-in-box and coin-op rhythm.
best: arcade game, event announcement, retro festival page
signature: **Thick stroke:** card and button 2px `--ink` edge; there is no shadow.
**Bold on yellow:** Text above accent is always `--accentInk`.
**Box within a box:** 1px inner frame within the component frame.
**Coin-op rhythm:** mono counter and 3-digit score line.
must: Card/button edge 2px and sharp; shadow is not used.
Only `--accentInk` text above Accent.
Scores are mono with 3/6 digit alignment.
essence: Arcade Cabinet brings the loud sound of cabinet art to the interface but maintains readability with contour and alignment.
brief: Design an arcade announcement page: dark blue background, yellow accent, 2px stroke, bold display header, mono score.

name: Stealth Tactical
tagline: Tactical interface: olive background, pale amber accent, risk indicator and monospace briefing.
best: tactical/shooter HUD, mission briefing, operations plan
signature: **Olive/amber:** two earthy tones; no bright colors.
**Risk indicator:** 4-stage mono label (low/medium/high/critical).
**Briefing block:** 68ch mono line, line spacing 1.75.
**Sharp corner:** 0–2px, 1px edge.
must: The risk level is always written in text, just not in colour.
Briefing text does not exceed 68ch.
Accent only active target and alert.
essence: Stealth Tactical builds tension by reducing information: there is only the target, the risk, and the single action on the screen.
brief: Design tactical mission briefing: olive background, amber accent, mono briefing block, risk label and single CTA.

name: Puzzle Light
tagline: Clear, calm interface for the puzzle game: soft blue accent, ample space and one-step progression.
best: puzzle game, daily challenge, educational mini game
signature: **Wide spacing:** section spacing 80px; The screen breathes.
**Soft blue accent:** true/active status; red only error.
**One step:** progress bar 6px, one piece.
**Round card:** 12/18px, single level shadow.
must: One target and one progress indicator per screen.
Touch target ≥ 44px.
For color blindness, the correct/incorrect icon is also displayed.
essence: Puzzle Light leaves the puzzle itself on stage: the interface retreats, leaving only the board and the sole action.
brief: Design puzzle game screen: light backdrop, soft blue accent, large space, single progress bar, round card.

name: MMO Guild
tagline: Guild interface: deep purple background, brass accent, inscription title and member table.
best: MMO guild page, member list, event calendar
signature: **Brass accent:** rank and election; The only warm contrast with the purple background.
**Inscription title:** Cinzel, broad tracking, uppercase.
**Member table:** rank column mono, row 48px.
**Guild seal:** 1px accent ring, next to title only.
must: Rank and date columns are mono.
Accent is rank/selection only.
Card corner ≤ 6px.
essence: MMO Guild keeps a community like a ledger: members, rank, contribution and history are read in one table.
brief: Design MMO guild page: deep purple background, brass accent solo rank, inscription title, mono member table.

name: Franchise Sports
tagline: Sports game menu: red-white block, giant title, player card and right-aligned statistics.
best: sports game menu, career mode, season summary
signature: **Red block:** Can be used as accent wide block; just white text above it.
**Huge title:** Anton 58px, single line target.
**Player card:** number mono, name uppercase, stats right aligned.
**Sharp corner:** 0–4px.
must: Statistics are tabulated and right aligned.
Contrast in Accent block ≥ 4.5:1 (white text).
The title remains on one line; If it is divided into two lines, the font size decreases.
essence: Franchise Sports brings broadcast graphic clarity to the menu: team, number and stats all aligned.
brief: Design sports game career menu: dark background, red block accent, Anton giant title, right aligned stats.

name: Pinball Neon
tagline: Pinball machine language: electric blue accent, yellow second tone, diagonal line and scoreboard.
feeling: spark, night, "don't let the ball drop"
best: arcade/pinball game, night event, music version
signature: **Electric blue:** accent only score and active target; yellow second shade with 40% opacity.
**Diagonal line:** 1px line inclined at 12° on section background, 6% opacity.
**Scoreboard:** 6-digit mono, right-aligned.
**Sharp corner:** 0–2px.
must: Scores are 6 digit aligned mono.
The cross pattern is only on the ground layer, not behind the text.
Accent single; The second color does not exceed 40% opacity.
essence: Pinball Neon brings the machine's scoreboard into the interface: house alignment, single electric color, and sharp block.
brief: Design pinball game page: black-blue backdrop, electric blue accent, mono scoreboard, diagonal subtle pattern.
